name: Fine Crab Chunks
summary: Fine Crab Chunks come from the Reef Crawlers and Encrusted Tide Crawlers along Darkshore's coast. Gubber Blump seeks them for his cooking.

sections.title: Fruit of the Sea
sections.body: Reef Crawlers and Encrusted Tide Crawlers roam Darkshore's shores. Travelers may see them as pests or dangers by the water, while cooks prize their meat. The chunks can be boiled, broiled, fried, or added to stews.

faq.q: What creatures yield Fine Crab Chunks?
aliases: where do fine crab chunks drop
faq.answer: Reef Crawlers and Encrusted Tide Crawlers along Darkshore's rocky beaches and tidal shallows yield Fine Crab Chunks.

faq.q: Who wants Fine Crab Chunks in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Gubber Blump, a fisherman on the docks of Auberdine, seeks Fine Crab Chunks for his crab dishes.

faq.q: Can you prepare these into actual meals?
aliases: can you cook fine crab chunks
what can you make with fine crab chunks
faq.answer: These raw chunks are collected for Gubber Blump rather than used directly in a recipe. Crab meat can be baked, barbecued, boiled, broiled, fried, or mixed into salads and stews.

angles.text: Gubber Blump knows many ways to cook crab, from soups and salads to pepper rubs and Ironforge surprise crab.
Supplying Auberdine's dockside residents helps sustain the Alliance outpost in Darkshore.
